rules.name: Microsoft Edge cache
rules.hint: Clears Edge's web, code and GPU caches for every profile. Edge must be closed. Cookies, history and passwords stay.
rules.description: Deletes only the cache folders (Cache, Code Cache, GPUCache, shader caches) in each Edge profile. Cookies, history, saved passwords, extensions and settings are never touched. Edge must be fully closed (including startup boost); iG Windows Tuner never closes it.
rules.sideEffects: Pages load a little slower the first time while the cache refills.

rules.name: Google Chrome cache
rules.hint: Clears Chrome's web, code and GPU caches for every profile. Chrome must be closed. Cookies, history and passwords stay.
rules.description: Deletes only the cache folders (Cache, Code Cache, GPUCache, shader caches) in each Chrome profile. Cookies, history, saved passwords, extensions and settings are never touched. Chrome must be fully closed, including background apps.
rules.sideEffects: Pages load a little slower the first time while the cache refills.

rules.name: Brave cache
rules.hint: Clears Brave's web, code and GPU caches for every profile. Brave must be closed. Cookies, history and passwords stay.
rules.description: Deletes only the cache folders in each Brave profile. Cookies, history, saved passwords, wallets, extensions and settings are never touched. Brave must be fully closed.
rules.sideEffects: Pages load a little slower the first time while the cache refills.

rules.name: Vivaldi cache
rules.hint: Clears Vivaldi's web, code and GPU caches for every profile. Vivaldi must be closed. Cookies and history stay.
rules.description: Deletes only the cache folders in each Vivaldi profile. Cookies, history, saved passwords, mail, notes and settings are never touched. Vivaldi must be fully closed.
rules.sideEffects: Pages load a little slower the first time while the cache refills.

rules.name: Opera and Opera GX cache
rules.hint: Clears the Opera and Opera GX disk caches in Local AppData. Opera must be closed. Cookies and history stay.
rules.description: Deletes the Opera and Opera GX cache folders under Local AppData. Profile data (cookies, history, passwords) lives in Roaming AppData, which iG Windows Tuner protects and never cleans. Opera must be fully closed.
rules.sideEffects: Pages load a little slower the first time while the cache refills.

rules.name: Mozilla Firefox cache
rules.hint: Clears Firefox's disk cache for every profile. Firefox must be closed. Cookies, history and passwords stay.
rules.description: Deletes the cache2, startupCache, jumpListCache and thumbnails folders in each Firefox profile under Local AppData. The real profiles (cookies, history, passwords, add-ons) live in Roaming AppData and are protected. Firefox must be closed.
rules.sideEffects: Pages load a little slower the first time while the cache refills.
